option_relations.rationale: Primary central nervous system lymphoma (PCNSL) is a broader category that includes Primary diffuse large B-cell lymphoma of the central nervous system (PCNS-DLBCL), non-germinal center phenotype, with cerebrospinal fluid dissemination.
Intravascular large B-cell lymphoma is a distinct entity from the specified PCNS-DLBCL.
Secondary CNS involvement by systemic diffuse large B-cell lymphoma implies a systemic origin with CNS metastasis, which is distinct from primary CNS lymphoma.

Lymphomatosis cerebri variant of diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL) is a specific variant of DLBCL, but the provided leaf specifies PCNS-DLBCL with CSF dissemination, which is not directly equivalent or a subtype of lymphomatosis cerebri in this context.
